task: rtl/irq_ctrl.sv is an 8-source interrupt controller. For a source with edge_mode[i]=1, pending[i] latches on a rising edge of src[i] (even while en[i]=0) and stays set until acknowledged. For edge_mode[i]=0 (level), pending[i] simply follows src[i] and ack has no effect. irq = |(pending & en); id is the lowest index i with pending[i] & en[i]. A one-cycle ack while irq=1 clears the edge-pending bit of the current id; a new edge arriving in the same cycle wins over the clear. tb/tb_irq_smoke.sv is the block's smoke test. Make it signoff-ready at 2.5 ns. Keep the port list.
